label: token right after a z, mid original phase (steps 3-5)
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase on the step right after a z was input (prev_tok == z gives 22x lift and 86% of activation mass), only at absolute steps 3-6, peaking at t=4-5; it never fires at t<3, t>6, or in the copy phase. The strongest activations are on z z X patterns at steps 3-5 (e.g. p v 2 z [z] [u]), where the token after the second z is near max. Precision is ~0.99 for prev z at t=4-5 and drops at t=3. Recall is incomplete because of a long tail of weak activations after 1 or f (and other tokens) at t=4-5 and at the delimiter step; adding prev_tok==1 at t 4-5 raises dev F1 only slightly (0.67 to 0.69). It does not depend on in_tok identity, L, or the first token.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: z, 1, f, 0, o, c; least: v, u, d, i) and the second original token (most: u, d, v, y, a, q; least: 3, r, x, z); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=5, L=9 & t=5.
